description: This file contains shell functions and scripts for automating Perforce (p4) shelve and unshelve operations, including tests for shelving, unshelving, and handling various scenarios such as revision mismatches and multiple files.

methods.name: last_shelved_change
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent shelved changelist number from Perforce.

methods.name: shelve_one_file
methods.description: Creates a new shelved changelist with a single specified file, including description.
